The first stable release of Among Terminal: a native GNOME terminal multiplexer
built with Rust, GTK4, libadwaita and VTE. Keep shells running in split panes
and named workspaces, with keyboard controls and optional status plugins.

- Split, resize and rearrange panes without restarting their shells; zoom a pane
  and return to the same layout.
- Switch between named, colour-coded workspaces in a collapsible sidebar;
  inactive workspaces keep their terminals running.
- Navigate by keyboard and customize shortcuts.
- Restore workspace layouts and directories into fresh shells.
- Add clocks, resource meters and per-pane status through separate-process
  plugins, disabled by default.
- Ready-made packages for amd64 and arm64: DEB for Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04,
  RPM for Fedora 43 and 44, an AppImage and binary archives.

See the [feature guide](https://github.com/Among-Terminal/among/blob/v0.1.0/docs/features.md)
for demonstrations of each control.
